failed_attempts.failure_scope: Known spherical-design curves supply the averaging principle and stronger existence scaling; transit and Fejer carrier defect are charged. Physical originality and hardware advantage remain open.

failed_attempts.attempt: Promote prepared pure-Fe nanotransport to ore export
failed_attempts.failure_scope: Oxide reduction, fresh atom admission, connected accessible Fe fraction, impurity rejection and continuous source/sink interfaces are missing; metallization alone does not imply recovery.

failed_attempts.attempt: Use terminal series wiring to erase local contact and collection cost
failed_attempts.failure_scope: Series reduces terminal current by N and raises voltage by N at unchanged ideal power. Every local contact retains j, conducting product manifolds short the series, and storage-spanning conductor volume/heat and duty cycle remain charged.

failed_attempts.failure_scope: Optimistic active electricity ~0.297 MWh/t already exceeds the illustrative ~0.260 MWh/t avoided gangue duty before contacts and other process costs. No established net advantage.
